notes.title: Beneath the Bleeding Moon has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

I'm making an announcement to let you know that [i]Beneath the Bleeding Moon [/i]has (finally) been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/70b21da0c6eb39cb7c621a16a085042789719102.png[/img]

I first showed off the demo of this VN 2 years ago, so getting it across the finish line was a bit of a challenge haha ;; I persevered, however, and now the full visual novel is out!

[i]Bleeding Moon[/i] is a historical boys' love visual novel set in Japan. Follow Haru, a cross-dressing young man, as he goes on a journey with the devious thief, Kishou, to break an ancient curse.

[i]Bleeding Moon[/i] is a little different from my usual visual novels in that it's less of a character drama and more of an adventure story. There's quite a few fight scenes, and it's (generally) light-hearted in tone, though there are a few darker moments.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/58a3b3f6c751b8dc76294c111b49a75b8e9c367a.png[/img]

There's also an r18 patch for anybody who wants it, which adds about 20k more words to the story and several animated(!!!) r18 scenes. This is the first time I've added animated adult CGs into any of my VNs, so I hope people enjoy it.

You can check the VN out here if you're curious:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553080

Thank you for all of your support over the years! It's appreciated! I'll keep working hard to make more visual novels that people will enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: Unluckily in Love: Fragments of Love has been released \o/
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that my cute (and free!!!) BL VN, [i]Unluckily in Love: Fragments of Love,[/i] has been released on Steam.
The release contains the first three episodes of a planned ten episode series. Each episode is a short, cute slice of life story featuring Yuel and Tavi, the leads from [i]UiL[/i], in various situations. The episodes are all standalone and self-contained, though they do take place chronologically.
The first three episodes combined make up approx 150k, which is... a lot of text... especially for a project which is free.

I was thinking of charging for future episodes, but since interest in this story is pretty low, I might just release all 10 episodes for free. It would probably be less hassle that way. I'll have to see how I feel.

Like I said, [i]UiL Fragments[/i] is a sequel to [i]Unluckily in Love[/i], so you might want to check that out first before reading [i]Fragments[/i]. It isn't required though, since there's a summary of the events of [i]UiL[/i] in the first episode of [i]Fragments[/i].

You can check out [i]Fragments[/i] here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486140

And [i]Unluckily in Love[/i] here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146500

Also, content warning: [i]Fragments[/i] is an r18 VN with adult scenes. They can be toggled on/off in the menu, but there are NSFW screenshots on the Steam store page.
Yuel and Tavi are also first cousins who kiss, so you should probably keep away from this VN if that would make you uncomfortable!

- ebi

notes.title: Bonus content added \o/
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm just going to reiterate a post I made on this topic earlier so it'll reach more eyes!

I'm writing this announcement to let you know that I've released a free update for [i]Unluckily in Love[/i]. This update adds a bonus scenario which can be unlocked after finishing the main game (if you've read the story already, you might need to play through the end of the story again to trigger it).

This bonus story is pretty cute and comedic. It's about 30k words long (if you include the optional r18 scenes) and it adds 10 new CGs into the game and a few new achievements.

If you downloaded the adult patch already, you will need to redownload it for the update, as the old patch is not compatible with the new version of [i]UIL[/i].

In addition to this, I also fixed up a few typos in the main game which were pointed out to me by an eagle-eyed reader, so thank you for that!

As always, please feel free to let me know if you've encountered any bugs in the new build (or any typos) and I'll try to fix them in a reasonable time period!

- ebi x

notes.title: Unluckily in Love updated \o/
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that I've released a free update for my cute BL VN, [i]Unluckily in Love![/i]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/c511f7cfaa03b60ddd909c4ef1f356dbd10777eb.png[/img]

The update includes a bonus scenario which can be unlocked after reading the main game. In this side story, Yuel gets turned into a catboy (for some reason) and Tavi has to look after him! 💙✨

The update adds 30k words of extra text to [i]UIL[/i], 10 new CGs, and several new achievements to unlock. I hope you enjoy reading it as much as I enjoyed putting it together!

If you've downloaded the game already, you will need to redownload the adult patch, as this has also been updated. The new build will not work with the old patch.

To unlock the new content, you need to read through the main story (you might need to read the final scene again if you've already read the VN). Then, the bonus scenario will appear on the main menu!

You can find the VN here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2146500

I've also discounted [i]UIL[/i] and my other two VNs about Yuel, [i]All Ashes and Illusions[/i] and [i]All Idleness and Ephemera[/i] on Steam, so now would be a good time to pick them up if you're interested!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1673020

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025720

Thank you very much for your support over the years; it's appreciated. I'll try to keep  making cute VNs that people can enjoy!

- ebi x

notes.title: My Lovey-Dovey Demon has been released! 💗
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

I'm writing a quick devlog to let you know that my most recent visual novel, [i]My Lovey-Dovey Demon[/i], has been released! Yay \o/

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e869aec72dd4182535668ade5c2d4530d9819120.jpg[/img]

You can check the VN out here, if you're interested:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183430

[i]MLDD[/i] is a VN that's been in process for quite a while. I wrote the script back in 2021, and it took me a while to piece the whole story together. The Steam store page was up for over a year before I finally released it, so some people have been waiting on this one for a while haha

It might have taken me some time to finish this project, but I tried to use this time to ensure that it's as polished as possible! The main artist, [url=https://twitter.com/Kimoreen]Kimoreen[/url], did a great job with the character artwork, and all of the cute chibi cut-ins by [url=https://twitter.com/Konayachi]Konayachi[/url] are adorable!

I also had some help from Harmonie of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44509628]Asminae Games[/url], who created Reborn a Zombie (available for free on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283350]Steam[/url]), to do some work on the various visual effects in this VN. That means this VN has some fun effects during the CGs which I've not added to any of my previous projects such as light rays, animated particles, and moving fog. I think it helps the VN pop, and it brings the story to life!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/76da6cae1c84a845dd2d5c2968af720c4f21c4b5.png[/img]

Speaking of the story, it's a pretty cute, light affair which takes a lot of cues from typical BxG slice of life VNs. It's quite chill and relaxed, and there isn't much in the way of conflict (which might be a bit of a rarity coming from me lol), so this should be a good read if you're looking for something cosy. It's pretty similar to [i]The Language of Love[/i] in that it's a wholesome BxG romance story, though it has a bit more of a comedy focus like [i]My Dear Prince[/i].

Everybody put a lot of effort into this VN, so I hope you all enjoy it! ♡

As always, let me know if you find any typos or bugs in the VN, and I'll try to fix them up within a reasonable timeframe!

- ebi x
